doc.plan: INTRADAY_STOCKS_AI_UPGRADE_PLAN.md Phase 6 (gate 2: market suits the strategy)
doc.signals: The six rules' signals in research dataset y2 (code f8d054b), outcome = simulated net bp at market entry with measured costs (net_bp).

sector_index.other: no sector (signal excluded from sector hypotheses)

doc.features: All at the signal bar's close, from closed 15-minute bars: sector index return since the day's open; the stock's return since the open; India VIX at the close and the median of its last 60 daily closes; breadth = share of that day's point-in-time universe trading above its own open at the close. Monthly expiry day from the previous session's F&O bhavcopy (near_expiry of stock futures).

hypotheses.H6_sector: TB signals whose stock's sector index has moved in the trade's direction since the open (side x sector return > 0) make money.
hypotheses.H6_relative: TB signals whose stock has outrun its sector in the trade's direction since the open (side x (stock return - sector return) > 0) make money.
hypotheses.H6_vix: TB signals on high-VIX days (VIX at the close above its 60-session median) make money; R signals on low-VIX days (at or below it) make money. Tested as two separate filters.
hypotheses.H6_breadth: TB signals with breadth on the trade's side (longs: more than 50% of the universe above its open; shorts: less than 50%) make money.
hypotheses.H6_expiry: All six rules' signals on non-expiry days make money.

doc.metric: Pooled mean net bp per signal of the filtered signals on the holdout, t-statistic clustered by session; per hypothesis (H6_vix: TB and R separately).
doc.decision: GO for a hypothesis: filtered holdout mean net > 0 AND clustered t >= 2. NO-GO otherwise. Always reported: the unfiltered mean of the same group and the development period.
doc.multiple_testing: Six filters tested at once: a GO makes a forward-test candidate, not a verdict. Every feature also goes into the Phase 7 scorer whatever its verdict.
